items.docs: Health check endpoint. Returns 200 if the API, database, and Redis are all operational. Returns 503 if any component is degraded. No authentication required.
List all registered jurisdictions and their verification capabilities (quick, deep, search, entity lookup). No authentication required. For active jurisdictions only, use GET /v1/config.
Returns BizVerify tool definitions in OpenAI function calling format. Use these to register BizVerify tools with any OpenAI-compatible model.
Returns BizVerify tool definitions in Anthropic tool use format. Use these to register BizVerify tools with any Anthropic-compatible model.

Get public configuration including supported jurisdictions, credit pricing, available features, and API status. No authentication required. Use this to discover supported jurisdictions and understand credit costs before making API calls.
Download the OpenAPI 3.1 specification as JSON. Use this to generate client SDKs or explore the API schema programmatically.
Request API access — creates an account if needed and sends a verification code to the provided email. Use with POST /v1/auth/verify-access to complete the flow and receive an API key.
Verify the email code from POST /v1/auth/request-access and receive a new API key. The email is marked as verified upon success.

Verify a business entity by name in a specific jurisdiction. Returns verification results synchronously if available within timeout, or a job ID for async retrieval via GET /v1/verify/status/:jobId. Charges credits based on tier: quick (1 credit), deep (15 credits), deep + force_refresh (25 credits). params.description: The job ID returned from POST /v1/verify

items.docs: Check the status of an async verification job. Poll this endpoint after POST /v1/verify returns status "pending" with a job_id. Returns the full verification result once the job completes.

params.name: entityId
params.description: The entity ID returned from a verification or search

items.docs: Get a cached entity by ID. Returns the most recent verification data for the entity. Entity IDs are returned by POST /v1/verify and POST /v1/search. No credits charged.

params.name: entityId
params.description: The entity ID returned from a verification or search

items.docs: Get historical verification snapshots for an entity, ordered by most recent first. Each snapshot represents a point-in-time verification result. Charges 5 credits per request. Supports pagination via limit and offset query parameters.

Search for business entities across one or multiple jurisdictions. Returns matching entities with confidence scores. Charges 2 credits per jurisdiction searched. Use the jurisdiction parameter to search a specific jurisdiction, or omit it to search all active jurisdictions. Supports pagination via limit and offset. Search is available in every active jurisdiction regardless of verification tier.
Get your account details including email, plan, credit balance, and all API keys. Use this to check your current credit balance before making API calls.
Update your account email address. Sets email_verified to false and sends a verification email to the new address. You must re-verify before using credit-consuming endpoints.

params.name: days
params.description: Number of days to look back (default 30, max 90)

items.docs: Get API usage statistics for your account, broken down by day, endpoint, and jurisdiction. Useful for monitoring consumption and identifying usage patterns.
Export all your account data including profile, API keys, credit transactions, verification jobs, and usage statistics (GDPR right to data portability).
Create a new API key with a descriptive label. The full key is returned only once — store it securely. You can create multiple keys for different environments or integrations.

params.name: keyId
params.description: The API key ID to revoke

items.docs: Revoke an API key immediately. The key will no longer authenticate requests. This action is irreversible.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of transactions to return (default 50, max 200)

params.description: Number of transactions to skip for pagination

items.docs: Get your current credit balance, available credit packages for purchase, and recent transaction history. Supports pagination for transaction history via limit and offset query parameters.

Create a Stripe checkout session to purchase a credit package. Returns a Stripe URL to redirect the user to for payment. Credits are added to your balance automatically after successful payment via webhook.
